The ghost/init preconditions at transition.py:308-323 and claim.py:156-169 are byte-identical code duplication

A shared cascade_parent_first helper must extract only the walk (ancestor recursion, cycle guard, benign-race TOCTOU re-check, error rewrap), while leaving _CASCADING_EDGES decision table at transition.py:415 unmoved because inbound reconciliation already single-sources the decision
The three cascading edges (open→in_progress, closed→open, closed→in_progress) must all remain functional after consolidation and be verified by parametrised tests over the live _CASCADING_EDGES table
The shared implementation must preserve caller-specific write primitives via injected resolve_parent and advance closures, and preserve ConcurrencyMismatch exit code 10 at the leaf for both surfaces
